top: Tops published frontier results on CyberGym
gaps: Weights in escrow: the deck lists escrow as a deployment assurance. It answers the buyer worry “what if the vendor disappears?” Confirm it is offered before publishing.
The deck positions the model as ahead on long-horizon coding in real repositories, not only cyber. The page mentions software work only in passing; no homepage number backs it.
Why it fits on site: the deck says the model is deliberately sized for a customer’s own datacenter, which the largest frontier models are not. The page never explains this.
